# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. Your `robots.txt` tells every crawler to stay away from the whole site, and the pages are built in the browser, so crawlers that don't run JavaScript see an empty page. The one unknown is the canonical link (GEO-015), because no site domain is declared anywhere in the code. **Cap note:** a search-crawler blocker applies (GEO-009), which caps the score at 40. The score is already below that, so the cap changes nothing. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking all crawlers in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` under `User-agent: *` asks Google, Bing and AI search crawlers not to read any page. This is probably the biggest reason the site can't be found. If the block is deliberate, such as for a staging site, ignore this item. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:1-2` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: *` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59. This fixes GEO-009 and GEO-014 (3 points each). ### 2. Make the pages readable without JavaScript - **Why it matters:** `index.html` contains only an empty `
`. Crawlers that don't run JavaScript see no text. The catalogue list loads only in the browser, from `/api/mugs`. - **Where:** `index.html:8`, `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6` - **What the code says:** `
` and `fetch('/api/mugs')` inside `useEffect` - **Size:** Large. It needs prerendering or server rendering, for example prerendering with a Vite plugin or moving to a server-rendering framework. - **Score after this:** 37–46 on its own. Other fixes add to it. ### 3. Make the Catalogue link a real link - **Why it matters:** The menu reaches `/catalogue` only through a button that runs `navigate()`. Crawlers follow `` links, so they may never find that page. - **Where:** `src/main.jsx:11` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small. Use `Catalogue`. - **Score after this:** 33–41 on its own. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and a sensible size | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt` | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed as intended | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2`; assumed you want to be found | | GEO-014 | Pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2` blocks Googlebot and Bingbot on both routes. No `noindex` found. | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on your domain | Can't tell | Not run | No canonical tag and no declared domain | | GEO-003 | Content in the server HTML | Problem | Not run | `index.html:8`, `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6` (2 of 2 routes) | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and robots.txt points to it | Problem | Not run | No sitemap, no `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` | Problem | Not run | `index.html:2,5` | | GEO-016 | Key pages reachable by real links | Problem | Not run | `src/main.jsx:11` | | GEO-017 | No snippet restrictions | Clear | Not run | No `nosnippet`, `max-snippet:0` or header code found | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Problem | Not run | `src/pages/Home.jsx:5`. Home has a problem and Catalogue is clear (0.5 of 1). I read `Nav`, `Home` and `Catalogue`. | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (information only) | Not applicable | Not run | Not present. Optional and not scored. | ## Other problems found None found beyond the rule results above. ## Worth considering - **Describe the product images:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:5`: ``. Add `alt` text describing the mug. This is the GEO-002 problem above, and it also gives machines text for the image. - **Give the catalogue content in text a machine can read:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`: `{items.map((m) =>

{m.name}

)}`. Each mug is only a name in a paragraph. A page per mug (with price, size and material) would answer what visitors come to learn, and could carry Product structured data. - **Add ``:** `index.html:4-5` has a `charset` but no `viewport`. Without it, mobile browsers may render the page at desktop width. - **Link onward from the home page:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:6`: `Thrown by hand in Bristol and shipped worldwide.` The page links to nothing else. A link from this text to the catalogue would help visitors and crawlers. - **Give each page its own title and description:** `index.html:5`: `Vite App`. Every page shares this default. Once pages are prerendered, give Home and Catalogue their own. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-015 (canonical):** no site domain is declared. Tell me the domain and I can recheck this rule. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. `geopilot logs ` checks real crawlers against their published addresses. - **`/api/mugs`:** the catalogue data comes from a backend that isn't in this repo, so I can't see what it returns. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site. If `Disallow: /` is deliberate, GEO-009 and GEO-014 would not count against you. - I read the 6 tracked files, which is the whole project. There is no `geo.config.json`. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
